newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil Tiger rebels kill 15 Sri Lankan security men.
newsitem.headline: Tamil Tiger rebels kill 15 Sri Lankan security men.

text.p: Tamil Tiger rebels killed 15 Sri Lankan home guards and policemen after overrunning a remote police post at a northeastern village early on Sunday, military officials said.
The Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels were also believed to have captured arms and ammunition from the Wanela post, about 28 km (17 miles) from the eastern port of Trincomalee, they said.
"The post was destroyed," said an official. "Twelve homeguards and three police constables were killed."
Several security men wounded in the attack, by a large force of rebels, were in serious condition, he said.
The attack came as the army advanced on the rebels' northern Kilinochchi stronghold in a week-long offensive in which 219 soldiers have been killed.
The rebels, fighting for independence in the Indian Ocean island's north and east, have suffered more than 600 deaths in the offensive, according to military figures.
